Leonardo.Ai

Visual concepting with a reusable brief.

LOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Create image and supported media candidates through Leonardo.Ai's design interface or documented API capabilities. MoreSpace can build creative concept boards, reference-led image queues, and approval workspaces that keep the brand brief alongside each version. We treat generated results as candidates for a designer's review, with the selected model and operation matched to the requested visual task.

Useful outputs

  • Candidate campaign images
  • Versioned prompt and reference records
  • Designer-approved production assets

Where we can apply it

  • Art direction → concept variations → designer selection → campaign asset production.
  • Approved product reference → image candidates → accuracy review → sales presentation visuals.
  • Storyboard brief → visual candidates → continuity review → video-production handoff.

Inputs we need

  • Brand brief and approved references
  • Required image size and purpose
  • Chosen model and generation settings

Delivery sequence

  • Choose a supported generation or editing operation for the creative task.
  • Create candidates within the agreed format and credit budget.
  • Review brand fit and factual representation before storing approved assets.

Expert review points

  • Confirm visual details and text match the supplied product facts.
  • Check asset rights and consistency across a campaign series.
